 - Tapping is done with the index (pointing finger), and all other fingers remain on the flat surface
 - The timer starts with the first tap

- 1. Immediately
The real-time experience of food: is good or bad?
- 2. In the short term
The 2-3 hours that follow: if we feel energetic and effective, or heavy and listless
- 3. Long-term
What we eat affects our health for the rest of our lives, for example, it can add or remove fat from our body, promote or weaken our immune system, encourage or discourage the occurrence of degenerative diseases etc.

In this regard, we have to evaluate each meal in these three time periods, on a scale from 1 to 10.

- Taste: do I like to eat it?
- Energy: in the next 2-3 hours, how effectively will it give me energy?
- Health in the long term: how does it affect my immune system, how does it affect the occurrence of diseases, how does it affect the rest of my life.
